About Pillar Health Solutions ( )

Pillar Health Solutions partners with medical practices to provide outsourced nutrition, dietary, exercise, and wellness support to their patients.
Our model allows physician practices to expand the services available to their patients without having to build and manage an entire wellness team internally. Pillar supports the operational infrastructure behind the program, including patient coordination, provider support, scheduling, documentation, communication, reporting, and billing-related workflows.
We are building a model that should feel simple and seamless for the physician practice, even though there are many moving parts behind the scenes.
That is where the Operations Lead comes in.
About the Role
We are looking for an Operations Lead who can build, run, and continuously improve the operational engine behind Pillar Health Solutions .
This is a highly hands-on role for someone who is comfortable working in a growing healthcare business where processes are still evolving.
You will work closely with leadership and take ownership of the workflows connecting physician partners, practice staff, patients, dietitians, exercise professionals, and internal support teams.
You may be investigating why patients are not scheduling, improving a referral workflow, resolving a practice issue, reviewing operational data, building a new process, creating an SOP, coordinating provider capacity, or implementing automation to eliminate repetitive work.
As Pillar grows, this role should evolve from personally managing many operational processes to building the systems, team structure, accountability, and workflows that allow the company to scale efficiently.

Practice Onboarding & Client Operations

• Monitor cancellations, no-shows, scheduling delays, and patient drop-off points, then implement workflows to improve conversion and retention.

Documentation, Billing & Revenue Operations

• Monitor the timely completion and flow of documentation and billing-related information between providers, Pillar, and partner practices.

About The Position
The Account Servicing Specialist (61+ Days) will be responsible for servicing auto loan accounts that are 61+ days delinquent and documenting all collection activities utilizing loan servicing software.
Essential Responsibilities:

• Follow and ensure compliance with all company policies and procedures as well as the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA).

• Negotiate payment arrangements with borrowers, including offering suggestions as to how they can meet their obligations, propose alternative payment methods, and establish payment procedures.

• Assist borrowers in devising a strategy to allow them to keep their vehicle while meeting the obligations of the loan.

• Accurately and professionally document account information and collection activities.

• Utilize skip tracing tools and reference sources to identify and locate delinquent borrowers.

• Other duties as assigned.

Essential Requirements:

• 2+ year(s) of experience in the automotive collections field working 61+ delinquency.

• 2+ year(s) of skip tracing experience.

• Reinstatements experience is a plus.

• Effective communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to read, interpret and apply federal, state, and local collections regulations.

• Ability to interact with customers in a professional, tactful, and sensitive manner.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced work environment and to work independently and as part of a team.

• Available to work a flexible work schedule and overtime as needed.

• High School Diploma or GED.

• Bilingual (English/Spanish) required.

title: SEO Specialist
description:
Salary up to $2000
What You'll Be Doing
You'll be responsible for managing and executing SEO work across client accounts, with a strong focus on driving organic traffic, rankings, and ultimately business results.
SEO Strategy

• Develop and execute SEO strategies based on each client's goals, market, and competitive landscape.

• Conduct keyword research and identify opportunities for improving organic visibility.

• Analyze competitors and search results to find opportunities for growth.

• Prioritize SEO work based on potential impact rather than simply checking tasks off a list.

On-Page & Content Optimization

• Optimize existing website pages for search intent, keywords, structure, and conversions.

• Work with content writers to improve existing content and guide the creation of new SEO-focused content.

• Identify opportunities to improve internal linking, metadata, headings, content structure, and other on-page elements.

• Review content and SEO pages to make sure they are useful, relevant, and aligned with the overall strategy.

SEO Page Creation

• Write SEO-focused copy for website pages and blog content when needed.

• Create and optimize location and service pages at scale while maintaining quality and relevance.

• Use SEO tools and research to make sure pages are targeting the right search terms and satisfying search intent.

Technical SEO

• Perform technical SEO audits and identify issues that may be limiting organic performance.

• Troubleshoot indexing, crawlability, site structure, redirects, metadata, and other technical SEO issues.

• Implement on-page and technical SEO improvements directly when appropriate.

• Work with the team to resolve issues that require additional development or technical support.

WordPress & Elementor

• Work directly in WordPress and Elementor to make SEO and content updates.

• Maintain page structure and formatting while making SEO improvements.

• Ensure changes are implemented accurately and consistently across client websites.

Off Page SEO

• Develop and execute off-page SEO strategies to improve domain authority, rankings, and local search visibility.

• Build high-quality, relevant backlinks through link building, outreach, digital PR, and industry-specific opportunities.

• Conduct competitor backlink analysis and identify backlink gaps and new opportunities using tools such as Ahrefs and SEMrush.

• Manage local SEO activities, including citation building, citation cleanup, and Google Business Profile optimization.

• Monitor backlink profiles, referring domains, and link quality, identifying potentially harmful or spammy links when necessary.

• Track and report on off-page SEO activities, progress, and results while ensuring all link-building practices follow SEO best practices.

Reporting & Performance

• Monitor rankings, organic traffic, leads, and other relevant SEO metrics.

• Use tools such as Google Analytics and Google Search Console to identify trends and potential issues.

• Report meaningful findings to the team rather than simply providing numbers.

• Use performance data to adjust strategies and identify new opportunities.

We're looking for someone who already knows SEO and can hit the ground running.
The right person will be comfortable managing multiple client accounts, digging into data, identifying problems, and figuring out what needs to happen next. You should be able to work independently without disappearing into your own world-you'll still need to communicate clearly and keep the rest of the team informed.

• At least 3 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably within a digital marketing agency.

• Strong understanding of keyword research, on-page SEO, technical SEO, content optimization, and search intent.

• Experience managing SEO across multiple client websites.

• Proficiency with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, and BrightLocal.

title: Sales Engineer (Marine Safety)
description:
Job Description:

• Drive organic business growth, by generating revenue from new and existing customers and markets. Own and manage all direct sales channels and the bid activity required to serve those channels.

• Provide deep customer insights back into the Product team, ensuring that the company deeply understand customer needs.

• Contacts assigned/agreed customers or prospects to sell company products within a designated geography or market sector. Focuses on meeting personal sales targets, new business development, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting specific customer problems.

• A minimum of five years of professional experience in marine sales or related industries is required for a diploma or degree in engineering or a related discipline.

• Deep familiarity and connections in the maritime industry.

• Technical product expertise, direct sales experience, and/or sales process support.

• Establishes trusting bonds with clients and provides solutions that are focused on them.

• Interprets complicated, copious, and occasionally contradicting data to solve issues in an efficient manner.

• Has open and comfortable relationships with a wide range of individuals.

• Arranges and sets priorities for tasks in accordance with company's business objectives.

• Approaches fresh chances and difficult tasks with a strong sense of urgency, vigour, and excitement.

title: Software Engineer – Mobile Team
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Product Engineer for our Mobile Team. This team owns Snowflake's most visible AI products - Snowflake CoWork, our agentic AI workspace for enterprise knowledge workers, and Snowflake CoCo (Cortex Code), our AI coding agent. In this role, you will build the mobile experiences that bring agentic AI to users wherever they work, spanning the full product lifecycle from conception through deployment.

AS AN ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

- Build and ship polished, production-quality mobile features for Snowflake's agentic AI products, taking ideas from design concepts through App Store / Play Store releases.

- Write clean, performant, and maintainable TypeScript and React Native code while adhering to engineering best practices.

- Actively participate in mobile and frontend architecture discussions, design reviews, and peer code reviews to ensure code quality and system scalability.

- Collaborate closely with product managers and UX/UI designers to convert user requirements into detailed technical tasks and robust mobile UI components.

- Partner with backend and cross-functional teams to integrate APIs and support backend services that power AI inference and data retrieval.

- Contribute to the web frontend where needed - this team works across mobile, web, and the broader agentic ecosystem.

- Use AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar tools) as an integral component of your day-to-day software development workflow.

OUR IDEAL ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

- 2+ years of professional experience designing and building production mobile applications with React Native.

- Strong product mindset - you care deeply about user experience and can be trusted to own features end-to-end, from ambiguous problem to shipped outcome.

- Strong hands-on proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and the modern React ecosystem.

- Solid understanding of core computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, UI design patterns, and state management.

- Proven ability to turn design mocks and product specs into production-quality code.

- Experience with mobile app fundamentals: navigation, gesture handling, offline behavior, push notifications, and app store release processes.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills for cross-functional collaboration across engineering, product, and design.

- BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

title: Hyper-V Engineer
description:
We're moving our private cloud off VMware and onto Microsoft Hyper-V. This is a hands-on build-and-migrate role on a multi-site project running through July 2027 across multiple data centers in the US and Canada. If you've built Hyper-V clusters, broken a few, and know how to fix them, we want to talk to you.

• Build Hyper-V hosts and failover clusters: Windows Server, CSV, Live Migration, iSCSI and Fibre Channel SANs.

• Plan and run VMware-to-Hyper-V migrations with Veeam, from pre-migration prep through cutover.

• 5+ years of hands-on Windows Server and virtualization experience, including production Hyper-V clusters.
• Real world VMware vSphere/ESXi to Hyper-V migration experience.
• Working knowledge of SCVMM, Failover Clustering, Active Directory, DNS, and Group Policy.
• Solid storage and networking fundamentals: FC/iSCSI SAN, VLANs, virtual switches, and NIC teaming.
• Veeam Backup & Replication experience, plus enough PowerShell to automate the repeatable stuff.
• A troubleshooter's mindset, a generalist's attitude, and the ability to explain your work to customers.
• Nice to Have:
• Microsoft (AZ-800/AZ-801) or Veeam (VMCE) certifications.
• Azure or AWS experience, especially cloud-based disaster recovery for Hyper-V workloads.
• An MSP or multi-tenant hosting background, plus experience with FortiGate, Dell iDRAC, or Live Optics.

We built our technology from scratch, with AI in it from the first line of code. The technology helps price the risk; the underwriter uses their judgment to decide. Ledgebrook is seeking experienced E&S Underwriting Assistant who has experience supporting Inland Marine, Builder's Risk, or Property talent to join our growing team, whose mission is to build a profitable book of E&S business across expanding lines of business and coverages. Ledgebrook ’s vision is to deliver market-relevant solutions to our key wholesale trading partners in a more frictionless environment that places an emphasis on efficiencies and quality to meet or exceed our broker’s overall needs in a risk-differentiated manner. If you possess an entrepreneurial passion with a proven track history of delivering high-quality underwriting support and seek an opportunity to break out of the traditional insurance company mold, we’re looking for you!
As a member of the Ledgebrook Underwriting Support team, you will regularly interact with Ledgebrook ’s underwriters and wholesale trading partners over the phone, virtually, or in-person to facilitate various transactions independently or with limited guidance. • A Strong Moral Compass: You believe in doing the right thing, period. We have a strict zero-tolerance policy for toxic behaviors.

• Intellectual Curiosity: You naturally question the status quo and love finding innovative ways to solve problems.

• A Growth Mindset: You possess a hunger for continuous learning and want to constantly expand your skillset.

• Team-First Energy: You want to win together as a high-performing team and actively build connections across our remote locations.

title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Bratislava, Slovakia
description:
Remote
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.
What You'll Do

• Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team - from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.
An Ideal Candidate Should Have

• 5+ years of software engineering experien

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

title: FinOps Data Engineer
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a FinOps Data Engineer to help drive cost optimization and cloud financial governance across our AWS infrastructure and GCP footprint. You'll work cross-functionally with Engineering, Finance, and Product to find and ship savings, build the tooling necessary to maximize efficiency of every dollar spent in the cloud, and cultivate a culture of cost awareness across engineering teams. This role owns the data side of that mission: the models, pipelines, and analysis that make cost, usage, and margin numbers trustworthy across the company.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not an analyst seat. You'll do the schlep work other teams don't have time for, digging into a bucket's access pattern, writing the dbt model or Python pipeline that ships the fix, building the cost-vs-revenue mart that answers a margin question once instead of every time, and chasing a number until it reconciles. Strong communication matters as much as technical depth, you'll regularly explain a savings case or a data model's implications to an engineering team, a finance stakeholder, and a leadership audience in the same week.

What You'll Be Responsible For

In this role, you'll:

- Find and ship savings across AWS and GCP: Analyze billing, usage, and cost trends to identify opportunities, rightsizing, storage lifecycle policies, data transfer, and spot/auto-scaling. Take ideas from identification through to a realized dollar figure, not just a recommendation.

- Build and maintain the FinOps data pipeline: Design and run the BigQuery/dbt models that turn raw billing and usage data (CUR, Storage Lens) into reconciled, trustworthy mart tables, the foundation everything else in FinOps is built on.

- Build cost-vs-revenue and customer segmentation models: Model unit economics and margin by product line and customer segment, and extend coverage as new products and segments come online.

- Apply data science to cost and usage data: Build forecasting models, detect anomalies statistically rather than by threshold alone, and quantify savings opportunities (e.g. storage lifecycle, request-cost patterns) with rigor a spreadsheet can't match.

- Build and maintain cost attribution: Tagging policies, cost allocation, and chargeback/showback so engineering teams can see and own their own spend. This is foundational work other savings work depends on.

- Automate cost governance: Build automated cost reporting, anomaly detection, and alerting. Write the scripts and infrastructure-as-code (Python, Terraform, Lambda) that enforce cost policy rather than relying on manual review.

- Partner with engineering on architecture decisions: Bring cost into the room early, cost-efficiencies are cheaper to get right at design than to retrofit.

- Work with Finance on forecasting and reporting: Support budget tracking and financial KPIs; build dashboards and self-serve analytics engineering and finance can both read.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

- Have strong AWS expertise and working GCP knowledge, including pricing models, billing structures, and cost optimization mechanics.

- Have data engineering depth: dbt, BigQuery (or an equivalent modern warehouse), SQL at scale, and data modeling for analytics (dimensional modeling, incremental models, testing).

- Have data science fundamentals: statistical forecasting, anomaly detection, and experimentation, and know when a rigorous model beats a rule of thumb.

- Have automation and scripting skills: Python, Terraform/ pulumi, Lambda, or Bash.

- Are comfortable with cost/billing tooling: AWS Cost Explorer, Cost & Usage Reports, GCP Billing Reports, and BI/dashboarding (we use Hex).

- Have experience with, or are comfortable picking up, Linear and Notion as the system of record for tracking and documenting FinOps work.

- Experience with a dedicated cloud cost management platform (e.g. CloudZero, Vantage, or similar) is a plus, not required.

- Can analyze cost data and present it clearly to bot

We’re a fast-moving team of aviators, engineers, and operators building an AI platform to make flying safer, more efficient, and more capable. Backed by top investors, we’ve secured a dozen Department of Defense contracts and partnered with major airlines to deliver mission-critical systems. We operate without silos or heavy processes. Small, focused teams own what they build, ship quickly, and learn fast, pushing the boundaries of how humans and AI work together in aviation.

We are seeking a Staff Frontend Software Engineer to bring technical leadership, strong ownership, and strategic thinking to our frontend team. In this role, you will drive the development of high-impact web interfaces that integrate with our flight safety platform, enabling users to interact with complex aviation data and derive actionable insights. You will collaborate closely across disciplines and play a key role in advancing aviation safety and operational capability.

What You’ll Do

- Design and implement React-based features while architecting frontend systems that handle large-scale, real-time and historical aviation data.

- Integrate, process, and visualize data from multiple sources, including live streams and archived datasets.

- Mentor engineers and drive best practices through code reviews and architectural discussions.

- Partner with backend engineers, product managers, and UX/UI designers to make informed design and implementation decisions.

- Ensure reliable, maintainable frontend systems through automated testing, clear documentation, and strong engineering standards.

- Build reusable components and internal libraries to accelerate future development.

What Will Make You Successful

- 9+ years of experience building and shipping high-performance, user-facing web applications.

- Deep expertise in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, state management, and modern web standards (HTML/CSS).

- Strong experience with asynchronous frontend patterns and efficient handling of live and historical data streams.

- Proven ownership of complex features or product areas, driving work from concept through delivery with a high degree of autonomy.

- Proactive, resourceful mindset with the ability to operate effectively in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

- Consistently sets and upholds a high technical bar through design decisions, code quality, mentorship, and hiring input.

- Ability to analyze and optimize frontend performance for scalability, responsiveness, and reliability.

Bonus Points

- Passion for aviation and a desire to improve air travel efficiency and safety.

- Experience with geospatial or mapping tools such as Mapbox or Cesium.

- Deep experience with live data streaming and playback systems.

- Experience with video streaming technologies and real-time media delivery.

Work Location
This is a hybrid role based in San Carlos, CA, with 3+ days per week onsite and the option to work remotely on remaining days.

Perks & Benefits (Full-Time Employees)

- Healthcare: 100%* of employee medical premiums covered; 25% for dependents

title: Solutions Strategist
description:
Vaan is a Shopify Platinum design & technology agency and the home of Brand Conversion Design.

We migrate, design, and build high performing eCommerce experiences leveraging our Brand Conversion Design framework, industry partnerships & deep eCommerce technical expertise. Solving the tension between optimization and design, we help brands make the most of their eCommerce.

About the role

Vaan partners with direct-to-consumer and B2B brands from $5M to $1B in GMV, across new builds, platform migrations, and ongoing optimization retainers. Our work spans development, design, A/B testing, and strategic roadmapping in one of the fastest-moving platform environments in commerce.

The Solutions Strategist sits between client understanding and technical execution. This is not a developer role and does not require one. It requires someone who can walk into a complex merchant environment, understand how systems connect, identify friction, and turn that into a requirements picture engineering and design can build against.

We value specificity over generalism, forward-thinking over comfort with the status quo, and partners over vendors.

Responsibilities

• Lead technical discovery for new engagements, migrations, and major projects, surfacing the requirements others miss

• Run structured sessions with client stakeholders across technical, marketing, and ops functions, and turn what surfaces into documentation the full team can act on

• Translate ambiguous business needs into scoped functional and technical requirements, including an explicit account of what is out of scope and why

• Decompose requirements into epics and stories an engineer can pick up without a follow-up conversation, working alongside the Product Owner to keep the backlog accurate as the engagement moves

• Maintain the requirements record page by page and section by section, covering features and functions, metafields, and the apps in play, with every line traceable to scope

• Work with Tech Leads to document architecture, data flows, and business rules, and to validate feasibility and scope before requirements become commitments

• Build and maintain the discovery frameworks and templates the rest of the team works from

• Translate what a client asks for into what they actually need, then identify the tool that serves it, with reasoning legible to the client, engineering, and the account team

• Maintain working awareness of what is already implemented across our portfolio, so recommendations build on existing stack decisions instead of duplicating or contradicting them

• Evaluate third-party tools across loyalty, search, reviews, personalization, subscriptions, and headless commerce, knowing each category well enough to ask the right questions and judge honestly

• Recognize when someone else on the team knows a tool better than you, and pull them in early

• Track Shopify platform updates, deprecations, and roadmap signals, and translate what changes into client guidance

• Advise on stack composition with a focus on long-term maintainability, scalability, and cost

• Map complex client environments across ERPs, PIMs, OMS platforms, CRM systems, and marketing stacks, including how they connect and where Shopify fits

title: Független Értékesítő - Dombóvár
description:
Helló! Mi vagyunk a Teya.
A Teya egy fizetési- és szoftverszolgáltatásokat nyújtó vállalat, londoni központtal. Célunk a kis- és közepes méretű, helyi vállalkozások támogatása Európa-szerte. 2019-es alapításunk óta olyan könnyen használható, integrált eszközöket fejlesztünk, amelyek segítik partnereinket a fizetések egyszerű elfogadásában, és hozzájárulnak üzleti teljesítményük javításához.

A Teyánál hiszünk abban, hogy a kisebb, helyi vállalkozások a közösségünk alapjai.
Azért vagyunk itt, mert úgy látjuk, a jelenlegi játéktér nem ad valódi esélyt a kisebb szereplőknek a nagyvállalatokkal szemben.
Azért dolgozunk, mert azt tapasztaljuk, hogy a bankok és a hagyományos szolgáltatók gyakran megnehezítik a helyi vállalkozások hatékony működését. Nem hisszük, hogy a legjobb technológia vagy szolgáltatás csak a legnagyobb cégeket illetné meg.
Egy olyan jövőért dolgozunk, ahol a kisebb vállalkozások is sikeresen működhetnek és ugyanolyan elkötelezettséggel támogatjuk őket, amilyennel ők nap mint nap építik a közösségünket.

Legyél a történetünk része!
Kivételes tehetségeket keresünk, akik csatlakoznának küldetésünkhöz. Nálunk lehetőséged van valódi hatást gyakorolni egy lendületes, összetartó közösségben. Támogatunk a folyamatos fejlődésben, büszkék vagyunk közös céljainkra, és átfogó juttatási csomagot kínálunk.

Csatlakozz csapatunkhoz, mint független értékesítő!

Proaktív személy vagy, aki szeret emberekkel beszélgetni és sok időt tölteni terepen? Kiváló kommunikációs készségeid vannak és szereted az értékesítést? Széles kapcsolati hálóval rendelkezel a vendéglátásban, kiskereskedelemben és a szépségiparban, vagy egyszerűen csak ismersz valakit szinte bármire?

A Teya-nál folyamatosan keressük azokat a független értékesítőket, akik képviselik szolgáltatásainkat kis- és középvállalkozások számára a fizetési megoldások területén.
A feladat egyszerű: találj egy ügyfelet, küldj neki ajánlatot, vidd fel felhasználóként, és a jutalék hamarosan a számládon landol.

Van saját céged vagy egyéni vállalkozásod? Remek! A vállalkozásod a hónap során általad hozott ügyfelek után számláz a Teya felé, így a bevételed teljes mértékben az általad elért eredményektől függ.

Miért dolgozz velünk:

- Rugalmasság: Dolgozz a saját feltételeid szerint, kezeld a saját időbeosztásod és határozd meg a prioritásaid

- Korlátlan kereseti lehetőség: Teljesítményalapú, magas jutalékrendszer, korlátlan potenciállal

- Függetlenség: Szabadság a saját vállalkozásod vezetésére, miközben igénybe veheted támogatásunkat és erőforrásainkat

- Kiváló megoldások: Dolgozz a legmodernebb kártyaelfogadó technológiával és POS eszközökkel

- Képzés és támogatás: Részletes képzést biztosítunk, hogy minél jobban megismerd szolgáltatásainkat, és folyamatos támogatást nyújtunk minden felmerülő kérdésre

Amit tőled várunk:

- Kiváló kommunikációs és prezentációs készségek

- Önálló munkavégzés és hatékony időgazdálkodás

- Ambíció, motiváció és könnyedség másokkal való kapcsolattartásban

- Ügyfélszerzés, termék- és szolgáltatásbemutatás, valamint sikeres értékesítés

- Előnyben részesülnek azok a jelöltek, akik terepi vagy személyes értékesítési tapasztalattal rendelkeznek, illetve széles kapcsolati hálóval a kiskereskedelem, vendéglátás és kapcsolódó ágazatok területén

Ha mindez jól hangzik, és szeretnél a saját feltételeid szerint dolgozni korlátlan kereseti lehetőséggel, örömmel várjuk jelentkezésedet!

A Teya elkötelezett az egyenlő esélyek biztosítása mellett.
Elkötelezettek vagyunk egy befogadó munkahelyi környezet kialakítása mellett, ahol mindenki, függetlenül származásától, nemi identitásától, szexuális irányultságától, életkorától, akadályoztatottságától, vallásától vagy hátterétől, kibontakozhat és a legjobbat hozhatja ki magából. Hisszük, hogy a sokszínű csapat kreatívabb ötletekhez, jobb eredményekhez és egy támogatóbb munkahelyhez vezet mindenki számára.

Ha a jelentkezési folyamat bármely szakaszában szükséged lenne bármilyen jellegű támogatásra vagy segítségre,

title: Solution Architect - Regulatory (RIM)
description:
Position Description

The Solution Architect is a senior, customer-facing leader with a deep background in Pharmaceutical Regulatory who owns the full post-sale journey for Kivo’s customers. The primary focus of this role is driving customer outcomes, retention, and expansion through proactive success management that starts with leading hands-on implementation projects and continues through to Customer Success interactions. You will build deep, trusted relationships with Kivo’s customers, lead implementations that set customers up for long-term success and serve as their strategic partner throughout their time with Kivo. This role thrives at the intersection of strategic account management and operational delivery in regulated environments. While primarily US-focused, the role may require occasional time-shifting to support EU-based implementation projects and customers.

Key Responsibilities

Implementation Consulting

Working in partnership with Kivo’s US based implementation team:

•
Solution Design: Engage early in the sales process to assist with the definition of requirements and project scoping

•
Deliver implementations: Lead end-to-end implementations of the Kivo platform through structured project management, and governance.

•
Design & configure: Facilitate discovery and design workshops; translate regulated process requirements (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 / Annex 11) into configured platform solutions with documented decisions and guide the adoption of Kivo.

•
Support validation: Support the customer’s validation workstream by educating customers in the Kivo validation methodology and providing an orientation to Kivo documentation.

•
Support data migration: Partner with the Data Migration team on discovery, field mapping, dry-run coordination, and production cutover checklists for compliant data transfers.

•
Enable go-live: Guide customers through change management activities: defect triage, go-live readiness assessments, user training enablement, and post-go-live stabilization.

Customer Success

Working in partnership with the VP, Services:

•
Own account health: Manage a portfolio of NA accounts as the primary strategic point of contact post-implementation

•
Drive outcomes and expansion: Build and maintain tailored success plans aligned to each customer’s business goals; partner with Sales to identify, qualify, and advance expansion and upsell opportunities within your portfolio.

•
Executive alignment: Cultivate senior-level relationships within customer organizations; deliver executive-ready insights, business reviews, and ROI narratives that reinforce Kivo’s value.

•
Champion the customer: Serve as the primary voice of Kivo customers to the internal team-surface product feedback, advocate for roadmap priorities, and collaborate with Product on features and packaged offerings that reflect NA market needs.

•
Manage upgrades and adoption: Proactively manage customers through new feature releases and configuration changes, ensuring smooth adoption and building internal champions who drive platform utilization.

•
Retain and grow the base: Own GRR and NRR metrics for your portfolio; develop and execute playbooks for at-risk accounts, renewals, and expansion conversations in coordination with Sales leadership.

What You’ve Done

Required

• 5-10+ years of experience in a customer success, implementation, or blended services role (e.g. Delivery Lead) within a life-sciences SaaS environment (pharma, biotech, med-device, or CRO).

• Strong domain knowledge in Regulatory Affairs or Operations for pharmaceutical/biotech or medtech industries is a must

• Demonstrated track record managing across a portfolio of accounts.

• Working knowledge of regulated industry requirements (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 / Annex 11) and comfort supporting validation deliverables (CSA/CSV).

• Experience leading software implementations in a regulated environment, including project planning, stakeholder management, and go-live delivery.

title: Associate Director, Pharmacy Hub Operations
description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Associate Director, Mail Operations Pharmacy ensures adherence to quality assurance standards, accurate tracking techniques and a review process prior to shipping medications to patients. Decisions are typically related to identifying and resolving complex technical and operational problems within department(s), and could lead multiple managers or highly specialized professional associates. The Associate Director of Service Operations is responsible for building, launching, and leading the patient and provider service operation for the pharmacy hub. This leader owns the quality, timeliness, and consistency of inbound and outbound service across phone and digital channels, including patient support, provider support, case follow-up, status communications, refill and program coordination, service recovery, and complex issue resolution.

As a launch leader, the Associate Director will establish the service operating model, workforce practices, interaction standards, escalation pathways, and performance routines required to deliver a differentiated experience. The role partners closely with Access Operations, Clinical Operations, Implementation, Workforce Management, Quality, Training, Product, Technology, Analytics, Client Services, and external vendors.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience leading healthcare contact center, patient services, provider services, hub, PBM, specialty pharmacy, or other regulated service operations. Success requires strong omnichannel service leadership, disciplined workforce and performance management, and the ability to balance patient experience, client commitments, compliance, and cost to serve.

Key Responsibilities
Launch, Service Model & Readiness
Build the Service Operations model, including channels, hours of operation, staffing structure, interaction types, call flows, queue design, escalation paths, and service standards.
Partner with Implementation on requirements, workflow validation, user acceptance testing, training readiness, cutover, go-live, and hypercare; assume steady-state accountability after formal acceptance.
Translate patient, provider, client, and program needs into scripts, interaction guidance, knowledge content, routing, and measurable service expectations.
Establish launch staffing, nesting, proficiency, contingency, and escalation plans aligned to volume forecasts and program complexity.

Patient & Provider Service Performance
Lead patient and provider support across voice and digital channels, case follow-up, program education, refill coordination, status updates, outbound outreach, and service recovery.
Own service level, speed to answer, abandonment, responsiveness, first-contact resolution, transfer rate, repeat contacts, quality, satisfaction, and complaint outcomes.
Implement daily operating routines for real-time management, queue balancing, schedule adherence, backlog control, escalations, and recovery planning.
Use interaction and journey data to reduce effort, prevent avoidable contacts, improve resolution, and strengthen patient and provider trust.

Workforce, Quality & Coaching
Recruit, develop, and retain managers, supervisors, team leads, service specialists, and resolution specialists as the organization scales.
Partner with Workforce Management on forecasting, staffing, scheduling, shrinkage, intraday management, overtime, and capacity scenarios.
Establish interaction quality standards, calibration, coaching, nesting, knowledge reinforcement, and performance accountability.
Build a service culture that combines empathy, accuracy, ownership, compliance, and timely escalation.

Experience, Complaints & Resolution
Establish clear complaint, grievance, escalation, service recovery, and executive case pathways with defined ownership and documentation standards.
Monitor contact drivers, repeat contacts, transfer patterns, escalations, sentiment signals, and failure demand to identify systemic improvements.

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle - creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

Paid amplification is how our creator work reaches beyond organic. This role sits alongside our Director of Paid Strategy and owns the performance of paid campaigns across our client portfolio - planning them, running them, and being the person in the room who can explain what the numbers mean. You'll also be the senior voice in the paid team, setting the standard for how we test and how we report, and bringing a Paid Media Executive up to speed as the team grows. Six months in, our clients should be getting sharper recommendations and our optimisation decisions should be faster and better evidenced than they are today.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the planning, activation, and optimisation of paid campaigns across TikTok and Meta, with YouTube in the mix - from media plan through to post-campaign readout

- Run a genuine test-and-learn programme against client KPIs: form the hypothesis, structure the test, act on the result, and write down what we learned so the next campaign starts further ahead

- Present performance to clients directly - regular reporting plus the data-led recommendations that come with it

- Mentor a Paid Media Executive, and set the templates, naming conventions, and QA habits the whole paid team works to

- Partner with our strategy and creative production teams so paid and creator work are planned together, not bolted on

- Track platform and channel changes and tell us what to do differently because of them

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 5+ years in digital paid media, in-house or agency-side, with deep hands-on ownership of TikTok and Meta

- AI Savvy, experience using AI in your workflow (Claude preferred).

- A track record of improving campaign performance through analysis you did yourself - you can walk us through a specific example

- Experience managing paid budgets of $1M+ and being accountable for the outcome

- The judgement to make a call that affects client performance and defend it clearly

- Real attention to detail on the administrative side: reporting accuracy, budget tracking, and campaign hygiene

- Comfort working with clients and teams across multiple countries and time zones

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience mentoring or line-managing a junior paid media hire

- Background working directly with creators or on creator-led paid social

HOW WE HIRE

A 30-minute intro call with our recruiter, a conversation with the hiring manager, and a panel with 2-3 people from the team you'd be working with. We share feedback within 5 working days at each stage. We tell you what we're paying upfront - no salary games.

 

AI is core to how we operate. Use it to elevate your work. But everything in your application should reflect your own judgement and experience.

title: Product Manager - Connectivity Platform
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Connectivity team owns how Plaid connects to the financial system. We bring banks, credit unions, and other data partners onto the Plaid network and build the integrations every Plaid product runs on. AI is changing how that work gets done. WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey ships product every week, and every release changes what our customers, our support specialists, and our AI Support agent need to know. Today that knowledge lives across fragmented surfaces, and the gap between what's shipped and what's documented shows up directly in ticket volume, resolution time, and the quality of answers customers get.

The CX Knowledge Specialist owns the source of truth: the articles, troubleshooting guides, and product knowledge that specialists and our AI Support agent answer from. You'll consolidate that knowledge into one well-structured foundation built for both people and AI, keep it accurate as the product moves, and use ticket, search, and agent data to decide what to fix next.

- Structure knowledge for both humans and AI. Apply taxonomy, metadata, and templates consistently, and write articles that retrieve and chunk cleanly for the AI Support agent as well as for specialists.

- Keep knowledge current through every release. Track what Product ships, and update or create the affected articles before launch so they're ready for the Enablement Specialists' training and for the AI Support agent.

- Close knowledge gaps at the source by owning the feedback loop. Triage reports of inaccurate, missing, or buried content from downstream teams, then update the source material.

- Mine ticket signals, search logs, and agent escalations to find missing content, stale articles, and areas with high deflection potential, then prioritize fixes.

- Build AI-assisted workflows for drafting, refreshing, and detecting stale content (prompts, automations, review queues) so knowledge scales without adding headcount.

- Run review cycles, ownership assignments, versioning, and archiving so content stays accurate as the product changes weekly.

- Serve as the day-to-day contact for SMEs in Product, Engineering, AI Support, and GTM Enablement to get content reviewed, validated, and adopted.
